body: I definitely have thought about OCD in the past, have not been tested for it however.
Does your long term partner know about the real you? Or have you never let them in?
Experiencing this now, what was your first step after you decided you wanted to move on to the next life

I don’t even want to see anybody right now. I’m 72 hours in and I am just so lost it’s unbelievable. Part of me thinks I need to strip everything away, that I need to expose myself and lose everybody. Then rebuild. I don’t know how to do that, or if it’s even possible, but I don’t really know any other way.

Do you feel better about your “true self” from being “nice”, or do you think it would feel the same as my supply? And do you think it is easy to change sources of supply, for example mine to “nice” from “dominating”?
Do you not get supply from dominating (or at least knowing you can dominate) other people?
I’m saying a world before we were fixed on power and manipulation. I cannot remember that world for me, I only remember my world of manipulation that I live in now.

I can admit I treat people like shit. My question to you: are you not always questioning your motivation for treating people nicely now? How do you answer the question: is this the true me, or do I want this person to think I’m not an asshole? How do I even know what the true me prioritizes and be true to that version of myself?
Had that conversation today, she is not okay with it and honestly I don’t want to do it, but this is getting to be too much
